security_and_delivery_invariants: LINE HMAC, Feishu signature/AES-CBC/token, WeCom SHA1/AES/CorpID and internal HMAC are verified against the exact raw request body before adapter parsing
duplicate security headers, duplicate query keys, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite numbers, malformed XML and unsafe encrypted payloads fail closed
raw webhook bodies and credentials are never persisted; only SHA-256, byte size and allowlisted metadata enter 0059
tenant and principal are resolved before the durable idempotency namespace is claimed
inbox and outbox claims use lease tokens and monotonic fencing; restart and duplicate delivery cannot acquire an already completed effect
dispatch_started without an adapter-confirmed receipt is MAY_HAVE_COMMITTED and enters reconciliation/DLQ instead of ordinary replay
SHADOW verifies only and never acknowledges, persists, claims or executes; LEGACY_DRAIN rejects new intake; only DURABLE executes transport effects
HTTP, WeChat DB watcher and Telegram intake share the same 0059 durable owner in DURABLE mode
Edge-to-Host input and Host-to-Gateway reply use distinct dedicated HMAC secrets and stable delivery identifiers
public transport administration/query routes are denied and health output is redacted
startup waits for the HTTP listener and outbound dependencies before starting the worker and producers
shutdown disables all new intake first; listener, worker and async-loop timeout failures propagate and leave the instance retryable

rollback: Set EDGE_GATEWAY_ACCEPT_NEW_INTAKE=false to stop every HTTP and non-HTTP producer while allowing the durable worker to drain committed records.
Wait until pending=0, claimed=0 and reconciliation_required=false before changing EDGE_GATEWAY_TRANSPORT_MODE to LEGACY_DRAIN.
If any MAY_HAVE_COMMITTED record exists, reconcile or resolve it from DLQ; never restore ordinary retry for an uncertain delivery.
Keep 0059 and its audit/receipt evidence. It is expand-only; do not run a destructive down migration against user data.
Never roll back to anonymous webhook acceptance, raw-body persistence, shared HMAC keys or dual execution.
